sentences.en: Australia's decision to deport the world's number one men's tennis player looked like a controversy over athletes and the COVID-19 vaccine.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚决定驱逐世界排名第一的男子网球选手，这看起来像是一场关于运动员与新冠疫苗的争议。

sentences.zh: 但对澳大利亚人民来说，事情变得不同了。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Australia Bureau Chief Damian Cave.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事，澳大利亚分社社长达米安·凯夫。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月21日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Damian, over the last few weeks, I saw a lot of headlines about Novak Djokovic and the Australian
sentences.zh: 那么达米安，过去几周，我看到了很多关于诺瓦克·德约科维奇和澳大利亚

sentences.en: Open.
sentences.zh: 网球公开赛的头条新闻。

sentences.en: And to be honest, my initial reaction was, okay, here's another elite athlete whose vaccine status has caused this big commotion.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我最初的反应是，好吧，又是一位精英运动员因为疫苗接种状况引发了轩然大波。

sentences.en: But I'm hoping you can help me understand the play-by-play, how we got to this point where the tournament is in full swing and Djokovic is not there.
sentences.zh: 但我希望你能帮我梳理一下事情的经过，我们是如何走到这一步的：赛事正如火如荼地进行，而德约科维奇却不在现场。

sentences.en: He's actually been deported.
sentences.zh: 他实际上已经被驱逐出境了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's really been quite a dramatic saga.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这确实是一场相当戏剧性的传奇故事。

sentences.en: I mean, the Australian Open is the first Grand Slam of the year.
sentences.zh: 我是说，澳大利亚网球公开赛是每年的第一项大满贯赛事。

sentences.en: It's one of the biggest tennis events in the world.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最重要的网球赛事之一。

sentences.en: And Novak Djokovic is the number one men's player in the world.
sentences.zh: 而诺瓦克·德约科维奇是世界排名第一的男子选手。

sentences.en: And he planned to come and hopefully win what would be his 21st Grand Slam, which would make him the most winningest male tennis player in history.
sentences.zh: 他计划前来参赛，并希望赢得他的第21个大满贯冠军，这将使他成为历史上夺冠次数最多的男子网球选手。

sentences.en: So for him, there was a lot at stake.
sentences.zh: 所以对他来说，这次比赛意义重大。

sentences.en: But there's a big challenge for
sentences.zh: 但德约科维奇面临一个巨大的挑战，

sentences.en: Djokovic, which is that he's coming to Australia, which is a country that has a vaccine mandate for everyone coming in.
sentences.zh: 那就是他要来澳大利亚，这个国家对所有入境者都有疫苗强制接种令。

sentences.en: So you can't get into Australia unless you're vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 所以除非你接种了疫苗，否则你无法进入澳大利亚。

sentences.en: And he hadn't really been very clear about his vaccination status.
sentences.zh: 而他对于自己的疫苗接种状况一直没有明确表态。

sentences.en: He was pretty cagey about it.
sentences.zh: 他对此相当含糊其辞。

sentences.en: And then at the last second or pretty close to when he arrives, he says, oh, I got an exemption to the mandate based on the fact
sentences.zh: 然后在最后一刻，或者说在他抵达前不久，他说，哦，我获得了强制令的豁免，理由是

sentences.en: that he said he had COVID in mid-December and thus didn't need to be vaccinated for six months.
sentences.zh: 他说他在12月中旬感染过新冠，因此六个月内不需要接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And there were rules in place that did say that he could get a medical exemption if he'd had COVID recently.
sentences.zh: 当时确实有相关规定称，如果近期感染过新冠，可以获得医疗豁免。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: So he wasn't vaccinated, but it seemed like he was going to be allowed to play because of this exemption.
sentences.zh: 所以他虽然没接种疫苗，但看起来因为这个豁免，他将被允许参赛。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And then that all changed when he got to the airport.
sentences.zh: 但当他到达机场时，一切都变了。

sentences.en: So he gets to the airport and the border officials who are federal officials say to him, well, wait a second, who gave you this exemption?
sentences.zh: 他到了机场，作为联邦官员的边境人员问他：等等，是谁给了你这个豁免？

sentences.en: The rules say that you need to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 规定说你需要接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And on your form here, it says you're not vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 而你这里的表格上写着你没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So he was confused.
sentences.zh: 所以他很困惑。

sentences.en: The border officials were confused.
sentences.zh: 边境官员也很困惑。

sentences.en: And what turned out to be the problem is that the exemption that he had was actually from the state government of Victoria, where the open is hosted.
sentences.zh: 结果发现问题在于，他持有的豁免实际上是来自举办公开赛的维多利亚州政府。

sentences.en: And so, you know, this was a kind of confusing problem because the federal government handles border control, but public health is handled at the state level.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这是一个令人困惑的问题，因为联邦政府负责边境管制，而公共卫生则由州政府负责。

sentences.en: And so there was basically, you know, not a whole lot of great communication between state
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你知道，州政府和联邦官员之间并没有进行很好的沟通，

sentences.en: and federal officials, which you would think would have been, you know, resolved before the world's best male tennis player shows up at the airport.
sentences.zh: 你本以为这在世界顶级男子网球选手出现在机场之前就应该解决的。

sentences.en: But in fact, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，并没有。

sentences.en: Wait, that's a pretty big breakdown in communication.
sentences.zh: 等等，这在沟通上是一个相当大的失误。

sentences.en: And it can't be the first time this has come up.
sentences.zh: 而且这不可能是第一次出现这种情况。

sentences.en: How has Australia been dealing with travelers up until now?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，澳大利亚是如何处理旅客的？

sentences.en: Well, that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题就在这里。

sentences.en: They really haven't been.
sentences.zh: 他们其实一直没怎么处理过。

sentences.en: I mean, Australia shut down its borders completely because of COVID and only recently started letting people come in as long as they follow the rules and are fully vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，澳大利亚因为新冠疫情完全关闭了边境，直到最近才开始允许人们入境，前提是他们遵守规定并完全接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: There's like a small window of exemptions for people who have medical issues that would prevent them from vaccination.
sentences.zh: 对于那些有医疗问题导致无法接种疫苗的人，有一个很小的豁免窗口。

sentences.en: But that's it.
sentences.zh: 但仅此而已。

sentences.en: And so, you know, really, the country hasn't had to deal with this issue of having people come in and dealing with exemptions until very, very recently.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，实际上，在非常非常近的时候，这个国家还没有处理过这种人员入境和豁免的问题。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So what happens to Djokovic then?
sentences.zh: 那德约科维奇后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: So these guards basically said to him, OK, well, we need to look into this.
sentences.zh: 所以这些警卫基本上对他说，好吧，我们需要调查一下这件事。

sentences.en: And then they left him in this room in the airport for a few hours.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把他留在机场的一个房间里几个小时。

sentences.en: They kept going in and out.
sentences.zh: 他们不停地进进出出。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, without a whole lot of warning, they come in and say, actually, you know what?
sentences.zh: 然后突然，在没有太多警告的情况下，他们进来对他说，其实，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Too bad.
sentences.zh: 太遗憾了。

sentences.en: We're in charge of border enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我们负责边境执法。

sentences.en: The border rules say you've got to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 边境规定说你必须接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Your visa has been canceled and you have to go.
sentences.zh: 你的签证已被取消，你必须离开。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: But Djokovic, who's always been, you know, a pretty strong-willed player and, of course, has a ton riding on this tournament, decides he's going to stay and fight this in court.
sentences.zh: 但德约科维奇，他一直是一个意志坚定的选手，当然，这次比赛对他来说至关重要，他决定留下来在法庭上抗争。

sentences.en: And so they detain him and he ends up in a detention center, which actually turns out to be a hotel in Melbourne called the Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 于是他们拘留了他，他最终被关进了一个拘留中心，实际上是墨尔本的一家酒店，叫公园酒店。

sentences.en: The back and forth down under that right now has the world's top-ranked tennis player confined to a hotel.
sentences.zh: 目前在澳大利亚发生的这场拉锯战，让世界排名第一的网球选手被困在了一家酒店里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's when a lot of people started paying attention to this story.
sentences.zh: 我觉得就是从那时起，很多人开始关注这个故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常引人注目。

sentences.en: We've seen protesters take to the streets outside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们看到抗议者在酒店外走上街头。

sentences.en: People are very upset.
sentences.zh: 人们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: Anger, frustration, shock even.
sentences.zh: 愤怒、沮丧，甚至震惊。

sentences.en: What a convoluted and confusing situation that Djokovic finds himself in.
sentences.zh: 德约科维奇发现自己陷入了多么复杂和混乱的境地。

sentences.en: He apparently got an exemption from.
sentences.zh: 他显然获得了来自……的豁免。

sentences.en: I mean, I think all of Australia and the world really is trying to figure out what on earth is going on in Australia.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想整个澳大利亚乃至全世界都在试图弄清楚澳大利亚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Entry with a visa requires double vaccination or a medical exemption.
sentences.zh: 持签证入境需要双重疫苗接种证明或医疗豁免。

sentences.en: And Australia's Prime Minister, Scott Morrison, comes out and says very forcefully that rules are rules.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚总理斯科特·莫里森出来非常强硬地表示，规则就是规则。

sentences.en: Rules are rules.
sentences.zh: 规则就是规则。

sentences.en: And there are no special cases.
sentences.zh: 没有特殊情况。

sentences.en: And even Djokovic has to abide by them.
sentences.zh: 即使是德约科维奇也必须遵守。

sentences.en: That's the policy of the government and has been our government's strong border protection policies, and particularly in relation to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这是政府的政策，也是我们政府一贯的强力边境保护政策，特别是在疫情期间。

sentences.en: And I want to thank the Australian Border Force officers for doing their job.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢澳大利亚边境执法局的官员们履行了他们的职责。

sentences.en: So no special treatment for Djokovic.
sentences.zh: 所以德约科维奇没有特殊待遇。

sentences.en: He's now stuck in this hotel until his case is resolved.
sentences.zh: 他现在被困在这家酒店里，直到他的案件得到解决。

sentences.en: But it turns out he's not the only one being detained there.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，他并不是唯一被关在那里的人。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: It's not just about Novak Djokovic.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于诺瓦克·德约科维奇。

sentences.zh: 那栋楼里还有难民和寻求庇护者，其中一些人已经在那里等待了多年。

sentences.en: Unlike Djokovic, who's there temporarily and whose situation is being closely watched by people all
sentences.zh: 与德约科维奇不同，他只是暂时待在那里，且他的处境受到全世界人们的密切关注，还有另一群人，大约30名难民和寻求庇护者，

sentences.en: over the world, there's another group of people around 30 refugees and asylum seekers who have
sentences.zh: 他们被澳大利亚政府关押了多年，却几乎没有得到同样的关注。

sentences.en: been held for years by the Australian government and haven't gotten nearly the same amount of attention.
sentences.zh: 他们没有犯任何罪，也没有被取消签证，但他们却被拘留了九年多。

sentences.en: They haven't committed any crime or had their visa cancelled yet they've been detained for over nine years.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕受到迫害。

sentences.en: They are fearing persecution.
sentences.zh: 他们无法回家。

sentences.en: They can't go home.
sentences.zh: 这些人是在逃离战争，逃离他们离开的国家里的各种政治问题。

sentences.en: These are people who are fleeing war, fleeing, you know, all kinds of political problems in the countries where they left.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们试图在澳大利亚开始新的生活，却和诺瓦克·德约科维奇住在同一个屋檐下。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're trying to live a new life in Australia and they're stuck under the same roof as Novak Djokovic.
sentences.zh: 因此，人权倡导者看到了这个机会，来引起人们对澳大利亚对待人的方式以及澳大利亚处理边境安全方式的关注。

sentences.en: And so human rights advocates see this opportunity to draw attention to the way that Australia treats people and the way that Australia deals with its border security.
sentences.zh: 释放，释放难民。

sentences.zh: 释放，释放难民。

sentences.zh: 所以酒店外有几十名抗议者举着标语，上面写着“释放所有人”或“释放难民”、“废除拘留中心”之类的字样。

sentences.en: So there's dozens of protesters outside holding signs that say things like free them all or free the refugees, abolish detention centers.
sentences.zh: 我叫乔伊。

sentences.zh: 我是一名来自孟加拉国的难民。

sentences.en: I am a refugee from Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 我是住在这个公园鸽子酷刑中心里的33名男子之一。

sentences.zh: 嗯，现在是34个了，因为周四，诺瓦克·德约科维奇加入了我们的监狱。

sentences.en: Well, 34 now because on Thursday, Novak Djokovic came to join us in our prison.
sentences.zh: 他只是像我们一样的人类。

sentences.en: He is just a human being like us.
sentences.zh: 于是，这家人们几个月来路过却几乎没有注意到的酒店，突然成为了关于澳大利亚边境执法和拘留政策的抗议和辩论中心。

sentences.en: And so suddenly this hotel that, you know, people have been walking by for months without really
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: noticing becomes the center of protest and debate over Australia's border enforcement and detainment policies.
sentences.zh: 所以这些抗议者希望利用这种情况，让人们更多地关注像那几十名寻求庇护者一样的人，而不是一位国际明星运动员。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.zh: 但更具体地说，这些人需要医疗护理，他们是2019年为了这个目的被带到酒店的。

sentences.en: But the conditions in this hotel are really tough and they're meant to be their own form of deterrence.
sentences.zh: 但这间酒店的条件非常艰苦，它们本身就是一种威慑形式。

sentences.en: The detainees in there are not allowed outside except for medical appointments and some of them even say that the windows are nailed shut.
sentences.zh: 里面的被拘留者除了看病外不允许外出，有些人甚至说窗户都被钉死了。

sentences.en: A few of the people inside have even posted pictures on social media of food with maggots all over it.
sentences.zh: 里面的一些人甚至在社交媒体上发布了食物上爬满蛆虫的照片。

sentences.en: It's meant to be tough so that it's not seen as this luxurious location for anyone who's trying to get into the country.
sentences.zh: 它必须很艰苦，这样对于任何试图进入该国的人来说，它就不会被视为一个豪华的场所。

sentences.en: The whole point is to be difficult so that other people won't do it.
sentences.zh: 重点就是要让它变得困难，这样其他人就不会再这么做了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's about the message of deterrence that you told us about.
sentences.zh: 这关乎你告诉我们的那种威慑信息。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The main focus for the Australian government is to use this migration system to signal to the rest of the world,
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚政府的主要重点是利用这个移民系统向世界其他地方发出信号：

sentences.en: hey, we're not going to accept you if you try to come here without going through the usual process.
sentences.zh: 嘿，如果你不走常规程序就想来这里，我们是不会接受你的。

sentences.en: Don't just show up because we're going to send you back or we're going to put you in mandatory detention indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 别直接跑过来，因为我们要么把你送回去，要么把你无限期地关进强制拘留所。

sentences.en: And that's just how the system works.
sentences.zh: 这就是系统运作的方式。

sentences.en: And what really drives those strict border policies is a tendency for Australians to trust their government to basically expect that their leaders will make reasonable rules that everyone will want to follow to protect them against anything they're afraid of,
sentences.zh: 而真正驱动这些严格边境政策的，是澳大利亚人倾向于信任他们的政府，基本上期望他们的领导人会制定合理的规则，让每个人都愿意遵守，以保护他们免受任何他们所恐惧的事物的侵害，

sentences.en: whether it's migrants or something else.
sentences.zh: 无论是移民还是其他什么。

sentences.en: And now the latest threat is COVID.
sentences.zh: 而现在最新的威胁是新冠疫情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So Damien, what happens in Australia when COVID hits?
sentences.zh: 那么达米安，当新冠疫情袭击澳大利亚时发生了什么？

sentences.en: You mentioned the government had completely closed the borders, and it wasn't until recently that they even began considering letting people in, like Djokovic.
sentences.zh: 你提到政府已经完全关闭了边境，直到最近他们才开始考虑让人入境，比如德约科维奇。

sentences.en: But I also know a number of countries imposed really strict restrictions and basically tried to seal their borders during the pandemic to try to keep the virus out.
sentences.zh: 但我还知道许多国家实施了非常严格的限制，基本上试图在疫情期间封锁边境以阻挡病毒。

sentences.en: So how is it different there?
sentences.zh: 那么那里有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: Australia's COVID border restrictions were more intense than just about every other country in the world, maybe with the exception of China.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的新冠边境限制比世界上几乎所有其他国家都要严厉，也许除了中国以外。

sentences.en: Australian citizens, for example, if they were out of the country when the border was closed and shut down, they weren't allowed to come back in.
sentences.zh: 例如，澳大利亚公民如果在边境关闭和封锁时身处国外，他们是不被允许回来的。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of them were stranded.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人被困在外面。

sentences.en: People who were here even had to get permission from the government to leave Australia, and a lot of them were rejected.
sentences.zh: 即使是身处国内的人，离开澳大利亚也必须获得政府许可，而且很多人都被拒绝了。

sentences.en: There were also really strict state border restrictions.
sentences.zh: 还有非常严格的州际边境限制。

sentences.en: You had to do 14 days of quarantine, even moving between major cities.
sentences.zh: 即使是在主要城市之间移动，也必须进行14天的隔离。

sentences.en: And a lot of families who live across state lines have gone years without seeing each other.
sentences.zh: 许多跨州居住的家庭已经好几年没见过面了。

sentences.en: But it was all supported, at least at first, because it really helped.
sentences.zh: 但这一切至少在起初是得到支持的，因为它确实有帮助。

sentences.en: Australia's COVID death rates are still some of the lowest in the world.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的新冠死亡率仍然是世界上最低的国家之一。

sentences.en: So I think in a lot of ways, COVID really exacerbated a lot of the issues we've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在很多方面，新冠疫情确实加剧了我们一直在讨论的许多问题。

sentences.en: Using the border as a form of security, psychologically and in terms of policy, the sense of trying to protect this safe country from outsiders.
sentences.zh: 利用边境作为一种安全形式，在心理上和政策上，试图保护这个安全的国家免受外来者侵害的感觉。

sentences.en: COVID really returned Australia to the isolationism that defined this place for so much of its early history.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情确实让澳大利亚回归到了那种在其早期历史中定义了这个地方的孤立主义。

sentences.en: And so how does that play into what ultimately happens to Djokovic?
sentences.zh: 那么这如何影响德约科维奇最终的遭遇呢？

sentences.en: Well, Djokovic basically arrives in a country that's still working out how careful it wants to be with foreign arrivals.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德约科维奇抵达的国家，基本上还在摸索对外国入境者要保持多谨慎。

sentences.en: So while he'd initially been granted this exemption from being vaccinated and a judge at first said that he could stay,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然他最初获得了疫苗接种豁免，法官起初也说他可以留下，

sentences.en: a lot of information came to light after that, which showed him basically just flouting COVID rules.
sentences.zh: 但此后大量信息曝光，显示他基本上就是在无视新冠防疫规则。

sentences.en: So in the weeks leading up to the Australian Open, it looked like he just wasn't really taking COVID seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以在澳大利亚网球公开赛前的几周里，看起来他并没有真正认真对待新冠疫情。

sentences.en: And some people were even calling into question whether he had COVID in the first place or just had his test doctored so he could get the exemption.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人质疑他到底有没有感染新冠，还是为了获得豁免而伪造了检测结果。

sentences.en: And even if he did have COVID, like he said he did, people wanted to know why he'd been photographed at all these events in Serbia around the same time,
sentences.zh: 即便他确实像自己所说的那样感染了新冠，人们也想知道为什么在同一时期，他被拍到在塞尔维亚参加了各种活动，

sentences.en: usually with crowds and often without a mask.
sentences.zh: 而且通常是在人群中，往往还不戴口罩。

sentences.en: It just looked to a lot of people like he was acting really irresponsibly.
sentences.zh: 在许多人看来，他的行为非常不负责任。

sentences.en: And so the immigration minister comes out after seeing all of that and says he's made this evaluation that Djokovic is a risk to public health and order.
sentences.zh: 移民部长在看到这一切后站出来表示，他已做出评估，认为德约科维奇对公共健康和秩序构成了威胁。

sentences.en: And so he cancels his visa.
sentences.zh: 于是他取消了德约科维奇的签证。

sentences.en: And eventually a panel of judges, this is kind of Djokovic's final appeal, says the immigration minister was within his legal rights to cancel Djokovic's visa.
sentences.zh: 最终，一个法官小组——这算是德约科维奇的最后上诉机会——裁定移民部长在法律上有权取消他的签证。

sentences.en: And within a few hours, he says he's going to comply and he's on a plane and he heads back to Serbia.
sentences.zh: 几个小时内，他就表示会配合，随后登机返回了塞尔维亚。

sentences.en: So he's gone.
sentences.zh: 所以他走了。

sentences.en: He's out of the tournament.
sentences.zh: 他退出了比赛。

sentences.en: He's out of the country.
sentences.zh: 他离开了这个国家。

sentences.en: But I'm struck by the language that you said the immigration minister used, that Djokovic was a, quote, risk to public health and order.
sentences.zh: 但我对你提到的移民部长所用的措辞印象深刻，他说德约科维奇是“对公共健康和秩序的威胁”。

sentences.en: Is that truly a public health determination or is that about something else?
sentences.zh: 这真的是基于公共健康的判断，还是另有隐情？

sentences.en: No one is saying he's a one man super spreader event.
sentences.zh: 没人说他是一个人的超级传播事件。

sentences.en: He did say he had COVID.
sentences.zh: 他确实说过自己感染了新冠。

sentences.en: And if that's the case, he wouldn't be infectious anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，他应该已经没有传染性了。

sentences.en: But what the immigration minister basically said is that here's this really high profile figure who has the potential to influence a lot of people to just reject the rules in general,
sentences.zh: 但移民部长表达的核心意思是，这是一个备受瞩目的人物，他有可能影响许多人去抵触整体规则，

sentences.en: especially young people who might idolize him.
sentences.zh: 尤其是那些可能崇拜他的年轻人。

sentences.en: And the law basically says that the immigration minister can deport just about anyone.
sentences.zh: 法律基本上规定，移民部长几乎可以驱逐任何人。

sentences.en: And that's what a court basically said, is that he has the power to do that.
sentences.zh: 法院的裁决也基本证实了这一点，即他有权这样做。

sentences.en: And what kind of message do you think the government is sending to the Australian people?
sentences.zh: 你认为政府向澳大利亚民众传达了什么样的信息？

sentences.en: Well, I think in a lot of ways it's about kind of standing in solidarity with Australians in the midst of this pandemic who have really, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在很多方面，这是一种在疫情期间与澳大利亚民众站在一起的表现，因为他们真的，你知道，

sentences.en: dealt with a lot and followed the rules in general.
sentences.zh: 经历了很多，并且总体上遵守了规则。

sentences.en: And in COVID, for example, you know, there were very few protests about vaccination mandates during lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 例如在新冠疫情期间，你知道，封锁期间几乎没有什么关于疫苗强制接种的抗议活动。

sentences.en: People mostly just obeyed as soon as there were vaccinations available, people rushed out to get them.
sentences.zh: 人们大多只是服从，一旦有疫苗可用，人们就争相去接种。

sentences.en: And so Djokovic, who's openly flouting all these rules, seems to be disrespecting the Australian people.
sentences.zh: 所以，公开无视所有这些规则的德约科维奇，似乎是在藐视澳大利亚人民。

sentences.en: At least that's the perception.
sentences.zh: 至少外界是这么看的。

sentences.en: And so I think the politicians are a lot of ways are saying, hey, listen, we recognize the sacrifices you make.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为政客们在很大程度上是在说，嘿，听着，我们认可你们所做的牺牲。

sentences.en: And we're not going to let this guy who's, you know, this rich, famous tennis celebrity break the rules that you guys all abided by.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让这个家伙，这个富有、出名的网球明星，去破坏你们所有人都在遵守的规则。

sentences.en: You know, this was the place where they were going to draw the line and say, OK, enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是他们划定界限的地方，他们要说，好了，适可而止吧。

sentences.en: You got to get vaccinated or you can't come in.
sentences.zh: 你必须接种疫苗，否则就不能入境。

sentences.en: Honestly, Damien, after everything you've told me, it seems like given Australia's strict border policy, whether it's because of COVID or boats arriving filled with migrants,
sentences.zh: 老实说，达米安，听了你说的这一切，考虑到澳大利亚严格的边境政策，无论是出于新冠疫情还是满载移民的船只抵达，

sentences.en: it was sort of inevitable that Djokovic would get deported at the end of all of this.
sentences.zh: 德约科维奇最终被驱逐出境似乎是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Looking back, I suppose it does.
sentences.zh: 回过头来看，我想确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: here's this foreign tennis player who thought he didn't have to follow the rules or the vaccination mandate arriving in a country that loves rules and a long history of really strict border enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这是一个外国网球选手，他认为自己不需要遵守规则或疫苗接种规定，却来到了一个热爱规则且有着严格边境执法历史的国家。

sentences.en: So, you know, maybe it's not surprising that he ends up getting kicked out.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他最终被踢出去也许并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I suppose the surprise might be that he even tried to come.
sentences.zh: 我想令人惊讶的可能是他竟然还试图过来。

sentences.en: And so how has this entire saga gone over with Australians who have spent the last two years abiding by these rules?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于过去两年一直遵守这些规则的澳大利亚人来说，整个事件反响如何？

sentences.en: Well, you know, Australians, I think, were pretty torn for this whole week as the saga was playing out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我认为在这一周事件发酵的过程中，澳大利亚人相当纠结。

sentences.en: They love having international athletes come and play tennis or pretty much any sport here.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢国际运动员来这里打网球或参加几乎任何体育运动。

sentences.en: But they also expect rules to be followed.
sentences.zh: 但他们也期望规则得到遵守。

sentences.en: And they hate anyone who thinks that they're superior, too good to do what everyone else does.
sentences.zh: 而且他们讨厌任何自以为高人一等、觉得自己不需要像其他人一样行事的人。

sentences.en: So, on one hand, I think a lot of Australians will tell you that they're proud that the rule of law was upheld and Djokovic received a dose of equal justice.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，我想很多澳大利亚人会告诉你，他们为法治得到维护、德约科维奇受到了平等的司法对待而感到自豪。

sentences.en: After all, he was held in that same dank hotel as everyone else.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他被关在和其他人一样的阴暗酒店里。

sentences.en: And he did ultimately get deported.
sentences.zh: 而且他最终确实被驱逐了。

sentences.en: But they're also left with a pretty bad taste in their mouth because the truth is their government looked pretty incompetent with all the back and forth over his case.
sentences.zh: 但他们心里也感到很不舒服，因为事实是，他们的政府在处理他的案件时反复无常，显得相当无能。

sentences.en: And Djokovic was treated differently.
sentences.zh: 而且德约科维奇受到了区别对待。

sentences.en: Unlike the asylum seekers, he was given the opportunity to appeal his case in court multiple times.
sentences.zh: 与寻求庇护者不同，他获得了多次在法庭上上诉的机会。

sentences.en: And it was resolved pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且问题很快就得到了解决。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Lots of people were invested in the outcome.
sentences.zh: 很多人都关注着结果。

sentences.en: Whereas for these refugees and asylum seekers, these truly vulnerable people, they're still stuck and pretty much forgotten.
sentences.zh: 而对于那些难民和寻求庇护者，这些真正脆弱的人来说，他们仍然被困在那里，几乎被遗忘了。

sentences.en: And so I think all of that has led Australians to think a lot more deeply about their border policies in a way that they really haven't for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这一切导致澳大利亚人开始比以往任何时候都更深入地思考他们的边境政策。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a country that's become fatigued with the refugee and asylum seeker debate.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这个国家已经对难民和寻求庇护者的辩论感到疲惫了。

sentences.en: And Djokovic somehow reignited, I think, a degree of reflection for Australians to really think about, well, gosh,
sentences.zh: 而德约科维奇以某种方式重新点燃了澳大利亚人的反思，让他们真正去思考，天哪，

sentences.en: if this is how our border policy works for someone who's a star celebrity,
sentences.zh: 如果这就是我们对待明星名人的边境政策，

sentences.en: how does it work for people who are more vulnerable and who don't have the kind of power and money that he has?
sentences.zh: 那么对于那些更脆弱、没有他那种权力和金钱的人来说，这又该如何运作呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it reminds me of that line you quoted earlier, Damien, that in Australia, sport is life.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起你之前引用的那句话，达米安，在澳大利亚，体育就是生活。

sentences.en: If it's the place where Australians build their character, it seems to me like this could have just been another tennis tournament, but it actually prompted this soul searching.
sentences.zh: 如果这是澳大利亚人塑造性格的地方，在我看来，这本可以只是一场普通的网球锦标赛，但它实际上引发了这种灵魂拷问。

sentences.en: It's prompted Australians to hold a mirror up to themselves.
sentences.zh: 它促使澳大利亚人审视自己。

sentences.en: I think that's the case.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of Australians hope that's the case.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为很多澳大利亚人也希望如此。

sentences.en: You know, this is a country that's, I think,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个，我认为，

sentences.en: really trying to figure out both how COVID has changed this country and the whole identity of the country and how this 20-year period of extreme border enforcement has also affected them.
sentences.zh: 正在努力弄清楚新冠疫情如何改变了这个国家、国家的整体认同感，以及这20年来极端的边境执法如何影响了他们的国家。

sentences.en: But beyond that, I think, you know, Australians may be reconsidering their whole relationship to the world.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我认为，你知道，澳大利亚人可能正在重新审视他们与世界的关系。

sentences.en: You know, after a lot of years of really focusing on border security, COVID has made them kind of misconnecting with the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在多年专注于边境安全之后，新冠疫情让他们与世界产生了一种脱节。

sentences.en: They're rule followers, but they also like to travel.
sentences.zh: 他们是规则的遵守者，但他们也喜欢旅行。

sentences.en: They like to have people coming in.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢有人进来。

sentences.en: And there are a whole bunch of families that I think, you know, are hungry to be reconnected with their relatives and with people in other countries.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多家庭，我想，你知道，渴望与亲戚以及其他国家的人重新建立联系。

sentences.en: So, you know, I think Australia is really trying to figure out what country do we want to be?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为澳大利亚真的在努力弄清楚我们想成为什么样的国家？

sentences.en: Do we want to be a place that has strict border security and that's what defines us?
sentences.zh: 我们想成为一个拥有严格边境安全并以此定义自己的国家吗？

sentences.en: Or do we also want to be a place that is open and has some common sense and reasonableness and fairness in the way we treat people, not just tennis stars,
sentences.zh: 还是我们也想成为一个开放、在对待他人方式上具有常识、合理性和公平性的国家，不仅是对待网球明星，
